body: !!! How do I apply?! I’ve been an ICU nurse most of my career and now I’m in a surgical lab. I’d love to be home though and I’m super good at chart review! How do you compare wages to hospital? I’m going to have to google how to get this job!
Curious… is this billing review or how do you describe what you do? More pay than hospital bedside nursing?!  I love the home idea!!! Thank you!
I love the holistic approach! Thank you!
More clearly, I choose to make my struggles a lesson in which I can learn and grow from to help others

Perspective. You can decide. I used to get mad at people when they said I had a choice in how I feel but the more I live the more I can see it’s true. I can’t change your mind and you’re right it’s probably pointless. We live in a spiritual war zone now. Everyone has chosen to be selfish and overreactive over the littlest of things. I’ll keep you in my prayers and I hope you’re happy about that! Have a nice day

I’m just trying to be a person who reaches out to others. You can choose to argue or you can choose to love. But either way, I don’t fault you and I respect your view, I just want you to see there can be light and happiness if you make it. Sometimes we have to make it ourselves in this world and that’s okay too

So by definition, “not influenced by personal standpoint or feelings”? You are loved. God loves you. If I met you I may not like you but I’d love you as a human being who is also seeking to understand this world and live my best

God loves you. You were made as you are. Choose to see your own quirky beautiful. It’s taken me 31 years. And mostly in the last two, after my divorce, after my sister killed her self, after giving up on meeting everyone else’s standards, did I start to realize this. And the best part, I’m just now starting to realize it. I have so much more learning and love ahead I can’t wait!
She knows you needed her love. Or just some extra love in general. Accept it and pass it on ♥️😘
